ideas.pitch: An agentic debugging tool that intercepts runtime logs, isolates root causes across multi-file codebases, runs regression tests, and submits functional pull requests autonomously.
ideas.title: AgentTrace: Real-Time Autonomous Debugging and Patch Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the winning strategy of solving hard developer pain points with a working autonomous loop, matching the hackathon requirement of an agent that thinks, uses tools, and executes tasks independently.

ideas.pitch: A background agent that monitors repository activity, pull request discussions, and commit notes to automatically maintain an up-to-date, queryable knowledge base for incoming developers.
ideas.title: GitContext: Autonomous Engineering Knowledge Capture Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven winning pattern of building engineering team lifecycle intelligence tools that directly target problems hackathon judges and technical leads face daily.

ideas.pitch: An agentic healthcare workflow assistant connected to secure Model Context Protocol servers to query patient records and summarize clinical notes while ensuring strict data privacy.
ideas.title: ClinicMCP: Federated Medical Data Agent with Model Context Protocol
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced architectural integration of multi-tool agent systems, fulfilling the requirement for complex system architecture and real-world tool interaction.

ideas.pitch: A self-improving semantic routing proxy that categorizes incoming prompts and dynamically directs them to the optimal open-source or commercial LLM based on cost and complexity constraints.
ideas.title: SelfRouter: Training-Free Semantic Query Router for LLMs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Hits the sweet spot of high-performance technical engineering and cost optimization, aligning with winning entries that feature self-improving evaluation loops.

ideas.pitch: An end-to-end IT support agent that ingests employee helpdesk tickets, triages severity, executes automated system permission resets, and requests manager approvals via webhook integrations.
ideas.title: AutoITSM: Autonomous IT Service Desk Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles practical enterprise workflow automation, satisfying the core hackathon focus on building independent agents capable of handling multi-step real-world operational tasks.
